verdictScale: PASS = observed on this host; FAIL = observed not to hold; UNPROVEN = not observable within the rules and budget

claude-code.cli: claude 2.1.247 (installed); the desktop app that hosts the operator conversation bundles 2.1.281
claude-code.measuredAgainst: real endpoint for identity only (no credential available); loopback stub model for every mechanics item

exactChildHandle.caveat: tool processes are not reported in the stream and run in their own process group

eventReplayAfterDisconnect.caveat: only the undocumented on-disk transcript; no terminal result or attach to the live stream

coordinatorDeathDelayedRestart.caveat: child keeps working and calling the model past the deadline; nothing host-side stops it

separatedUsageAttribution.caveat: plumbing measured with stub-reported usage; real-model usage and subagent separation unobserved

codex.cli: codex-cli 0.144.1 (Homebrew); the ChatGPT desktop app bundles 0.155.0-alpha.16.3
codex.measuredAgainst: real ChatGPT subscription turns on probe-owned app-servers

attachExclusiveWhileLive.caveat: thread/resume attach works; exclusivity against a second live client not tested

knownHostConcurrency.caveat: one active turn per thread observed; no declared limit

exactChildHandle.caveat: commandExecution.processId is a PTY session id, not an OS pid; a retried turn/start can return a turn id that never completes

eventReplayAfterDisconnect.caveat: persisted/resumed state, not re-delivery of missed notifications; stdio server dies with its client

toolCleanupAfterHostProcessKilled.caveat: SIGKILL of the app-server was not tested; its own shutdown on client EOF removed the tool at once

coordinatorDeathDelayedRestart.caveat: no expiry field; stdio server fail-stops with its client, a surviving socket server keeps the turn and its tool running until reattach
